caption: Dubbed The Newsboy, this Robin was purchased in 1929 by the Daily Gazette newspaper of McCook, Nebraska. It flew 600 km a day to deliver 5,000 newspapers to 40 towns across rural Nebraska and Kansas. Publisher Harry Strunk hired pilot Steve Tuttle to deliver the Gazette in the morning and (hopefully) defray costs by selling flying lessons in the afternoon. At each town, Tuttle would drop a bundle of newspapers out of a hole in the bottom of the fuselage. After sustaining damage in a tornado, the aircraft was eventually sold, repaired, and flown sporadically in the ensuing decades. Restored in the late 1960s, it has been on loan to The Museum of Flight since 1972.
